wording.why: Players count blinks (Ezreal, Katarina, Kassadin) as dashes; the Rule excludes them, so the biggest group of Misses will feel unfair.
wording.suggestion: Name a champion with a dash or leap (blinks and teleports don't count)

fun.why: 98 of 173 champions fit, so almost any guess lands and a full set is out of reach. Naming the obvious ones is easy; the interesting part is remembering tanks and supports (Ornn, Braum, Leona) and avoiding the blink trap.
